label: AC-16(6)
title: Maintenance of Attribute Association

statement.prose: Require personnel to associate and maintain the association of {{ insert: param, ac-16.6_prm_1 }} with {{ insert: param, ac-16.6_prm_2 }} in accordance with {{ insert: param, ac-16.6_prm_3 }}.

guidance: Maintaining attribute association requires individual users (as opposed to the system) to maintain associations of defined security and privacy attributes with subjects and objects.

params.label: security attributes
guidelines: security attributes to be associated with subjects are defined;

params.label: security attributes
guidelines: security attributes to be associated with objects are defined;

params.label: privacy attributes
guidelines: privacy attributes to be associated with subjects are defined;

params.label: privacy attributes
guidelines: privacy attributes to be associated with objects are defined;

params.label: subjects
guidelines: subjects to be associated with information security attributes are defined;

params.label: objects
guidelines: objects to be associated with information security attributes are defined;

params.label: subjects
guidelines: subjects to be associated with privacy attributes are defined;

params.label: objects
guidelines: objects to be associated with privacy attributes are defined;

params.label: security policies
guidelines: security policies that require personnel to associate and maintain the association of security and privacy attributes with subjects and objects;

guidelines: privacy policies that require personnel to associate and maintain the association of security and privacy attributes with subjects and objects;
